interface.longDescription: Screen installed fire sprinklers using photos, markings, models and SINs. Includes expanded U.S. recall and warning records, dated notice summaries, Tyco model and seal-style tables, historical identification PDFs, 44 UL and FM Approvals counterfeit and falsified-certificate alerts with external identification cues, source retrieval limitations, and field identification rules. Uses bundled references first, with focused current-source checks and broader searches when identification or coverage is unresolved. Distinguishes confirmed matches from uncertain identification and keeps counterfeit alerts separate from recalls. Informational screening aid only: not an inspection, engineering opinion, product authentication or code compliance determination. Personal project, not affiliated with any employer, manufacturer or certification body; see DISCLAIMER.md.
